end.parentNote: Ishita practised drawing square-number pictures and showing sequence growth by adding a row and a column. They explained that the shared corner must be counted once when adding dots. In the final tile example, they mixed up whether the shared corner should be added or subtracted; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask them to draw two successive squares and mark the overlapping corner before counting.
